rationale: Marceli brings product design expertise centered on user experience, while Lene combines UX design with deep technical systems work in functional programming and data structures—making them natural collaborators on building thoughtfully-designed, technically robust products. Both operate at the intersection of design and engineering, where Marceli's user-centered approach could complement Lene's architectural depth.
intro_message: Marceli Rogała, meet Lene Leth Rasmussen — both of you bridge design and engineering, and could offer each other valuable perspective on balancing user experience with systems-level implementation.
